subject: Marketplace catalog: canary deployment playbook & onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Sofia Patel <sofia@hybridisv.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, partner@cloudbridge.io
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing: canary idea & deployment runbook (initial)

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the intro last week — excited to get HybridISV into the Redwood marketplace. We've started drafting a deployment runbook to support the listing and the early canary tests. Attached is the current draft (hybridisv-deployment-runbook-v1.pdf) — it includes the test matrices for AWS/GCP, sample IAM roles, and a small traffic shaping plan for canary waves.

High-level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood confirm required telemetry events and naming conventions for the catalog listing?
- Who will be the primary contact for canary scheduling (time windows + peak avoidance)?
- Any constraints around preview pricing SKUs for the first 30 days?

We've penciled in a 2-week canary window followed by a staged ramp if the KPI pass rate is >= 95% for latency and 99.9% for availability.

Attachments: hybridisv-deployment-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Thanks,
Sofia Patel
Head of Engineering, HybridISV
sofia@hybridisv.com
+1 415-555-0172

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Patel <sofia@hybridisv.com>, partner@cloudbridge.io
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: canary idea & deployment runbook (initial)

Sofia — thanks for the runbook, looks like a solid start. Looping in Olga for technical validation and Ben for catalog/gtm asks. Vivek, flagging for co-sell alignment.

Quick notes from our side:
- Telemetry: we require the three core events (request_received, request_completed, inference_error) and the token_count dimension. Naming convention details in the attached template (redwood-catalog-template.xlsx).
- Canary contact: Olga will own scheduling for the first wave; I can handle the post-canary product checklist and marketplace catalog publish steps.
- Pricing: we can offer a preview SKU for 30 days but accounting needs the SKU mapping before go-live — Ben will follow up with the revenue routing.

Proposed immediate next steps (can we confirm by EOD tomorrow?):
1) Olga to validate runbook's IAM and test vectors and propose one minor revision to the traffic shaping window.
2) HybridISV to fill the catalog template with SKU and telemetry identifiers.
3) Redwood to open a Jira (PLAT-9523) to track canary tasks and monitoring dashboards.

I've attached the redwood-catalog-template.xlsx to make fills easier.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-catalog-template.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Sofia Patel <sofia@hybridisv.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: canary idea & deployment runbook (initial)

Markus / Sofia — read through the runbook this morning. A few technical comments inline below and one action item for HybridISV.

Inline notes (summary):
- IAM: the runbook asks for broad s3:* permissions for model artifact snapshots — please scope to s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject for the listing bucket.
- KV cache priming: add a step to include a warm-up traffic generator that hits the common prompt prefixes; that reduces early tail latency.
- Canary windows: prefer two short waves (4 hours each) during low-traffic windows rather than a single 2-week unbroken window. We can accelerate rollback if metrics deviate.

Action: Sofia — can you add the exact streaming token metric name (we expect token_count_total) and confirm whether you will publish detailed model tags (arch, quantization) in the catalog? That determines which runtime variants we should pin for the canary.

I'll schedule a 30-minute technical sync tomorrow (Wed) 10:00 AM PT to walk through the IAM and test harness steps. If that works, please accept the invite.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: Sofia Patel <sofia@hybridisv.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, partner@cloudbridge.io
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing: canary idea & deployment runbook (initial)

Thanks everyone — all good notes. Quick responses: 
- We'll restrict S3 permissions to PutObject/GetObject and update the runbook by EOD tomorrow.
- token_count_total is the metric name we will emit; we'll populate it in the catalog template today.
- We'll include model tags (arch: llama2, q:8bit) in the SKU metadata — that should let you pin the lighter runtime variant for early waves.

Ben — for pricing SKU mapping, can you confirm preferred revenue routing (resale vs. sell-with) and whether we should request an initial promotional credit for early customers?

Accepted the Wed 10:00 AM PT invite for the technical sync. I'll bring the test harness owner.

Regards,
Sofia
Head of Engineering, HybridISV
